title: Use Seedance 2.5 in CapCut and attach up to 50 multimodal reference assets to a…
content: Use Seedance 2.5 in CapCut and attach up to 50 multimodal reference assets to a single prompt to keep AI character faces and style consistent across generations.
tips: Use Seedance 2.5 in CapCut and attach up to 50 multimodal reference assets to a single prompt to keep AI character faces and style consistent across generations.

es.content: Usa Seedance 2.5 en CapCut y adjunta hasta 50 activos de referencia multimodal a un solo prompt para mantener la consistencia de los rostros y el estilo de los personajes de IA a lo largo de las generaciones.

fr.content: Utilisez Seedance 2.5 dans CapCut et attachez jusqu'à 50 ressources de référence multimodales à un seul prompt pour maintenir la cohérence des visages et du style des personnages IA à travers les générations.

ja.content:
---
CapCutでSeedance 2.5を使用し、最大50のマルチモーダル参照アセットを1つのプロンプトに添付して、AIキャラクターの顔とスタイルを世代間で一貫させることができます。
---

ko.content: CapCut에서 Seedance 2.5를 사용하고, 하나의 prompt에 최대 50개의 멀티모달 참조 자산을 첨부하여 AI 캐릭터의 얼굴과 스타일을 세대 간 일관되게 유지하세요.

pt.content: Use o Seedance 2.5 no CapCut e anexe até 50 ativos de referência multimodais a um único prompt para manter os rostos dos personagens de IA e o estilo consistentes em todas as gerações.

zh.content: 在CapCut中使用Seedance 2.5，并在单个prompt中附加多达50个多模态参考素材，以保持AI角色面部和风格在各代之间的一致性。
